#include <array>
using namespace std;
const int M = 16;
long long num[M];
int solve(long long k, int idx, int bitmask){
	if(k == 0)
		return 0;
	long long local_k = k;
	if(bitmask % 2)
		local_k -= num[idx];
	long long cost = abs(local_k - (local_k % num[idx] + num[idx]) % num[idx]) * (idx + 1);
	return cost + solve(local_k, idx - 1, bitmask / 2);
}
int main(){
	long long numbers;
	cin >> numbers;

	long long answer = numbers;
	for(int bitmask = 0; bitmask < (1 << M) - 1; ++bitmask){
		answer = min(answer, (long long)solve(numbers, M - 1, bitmask));
	}
	cout << answer << '\n';
};
